technical_and_design_decisions: Utilize Spring Batch for job processing and lifecycle management to handle batch jobs efficiently.
Implement Java Configuration to replace XML for module definitions, reducing configuration complexity and improving maintainability.
Design a pluggable Service Provider Interface (SPI) for deployment mechanisms to enhance flexibility across different container environments like Lattice/Diego.
Integrate Hadoop HDFS for file storage and access to support configuration files and script hosting, enabling data science workflows.
Adopt an incremental migration strategy for the wiki to the project repository to ensure smooth version control and documentation management.
assumptions: I am the sole developer with full access to the codebase, development tools, and necessary environments (e.g., HDFS, Spring XD setup).
The project uses standard Java development practices, build tools like Gradle, and version control (e.g., Git).
All changes are backward-compatible unless explicitly required by the user stories, and regression testing will be performed.
HDFS and Hadoop clusters are accessible in the development and testing environments.
Documentation updates are straightforward and involve minimal content restructuring, focusing on adding short descriptions.
The error in U5 is due to deployment configuration issues and can be resolved with code changes without extensive debugging.
Effort estimates are based on typical software development tasks and assume productive workdays of 8 hours.

activities.activity_description: Migrate the existing wiki content to the project repository, set up version control hooks, and ensure proper documentation structure for tagging and versioning.
Add Hadoop namenode specifics in a configuration file and implement code to auto-configure the namenode location in DSL sessions, eliminating manual setup.
Modify the jdbchdfs batch job to support passthrough mode without chunk processing, reducing read/write overhead and improving performance.
Decouple execution context from job launch lifecycle, refactor the XD-2486 workaround, and upgrade to a new Spring Batch release to inherit fixes and avoid CL and serialization errors.
Create a custom job module using Java Configuration to avoid XML, and resolve the deployment error where the job is not found by addressing configuration issues.
Continue the XD-on-Lattice/Diego PoC, focusing on designing a pluggable SPI for deployment mechanisms with the Receptor API as one implementation option.
Update all module documentation to include shortDescription fields, providing users with concise information about each module's functionality.
Implement functionality to host and read Python scripts from HDFS for use in the XD shell processor on Cloud Foundry, enabling data science script integration.
